findings.summary: The URL builder relies on a private word validator that duplicates the Reader selection validator.
findings.consequence: The two copies can drift and make legacy and embed lookup paths accept different word sets.
findings.evidence: readerLookupWord and validatedReaderWord independently trim, enforce the same length limit, and reject the same whitespace and control classes.
findings.recommendation: Own one Reader-word normalization policy and reuse it at selection and URL boundaries.
verification: Compared both validators and their selection/URL callers.
